accepted_budget.start: 独立核实者第一次工具先记录真实起点，须早于任何输入读取。

inputs.accounting: 新任务新增一次私有 case 阅读，单列 64,440 字节；此前人工阅读保持 1 次，完成后累计人工阅读为 2 次，不能重置或把新增读取归入旧预算。只在内存复用，不打印私有内容。

prohibited: 修改、覆盖、重命名旧证据或修改旧验收状态
重跑机器实验、教师、适配器、核对器、原检查或官方状态转移
读取原压缩数据、Replay、模型、其他来源、其他报告或全仓源码
重新核算已经完成的 60/68 项计量、全部历史 SHA 或 6,901 条历史路径
扩样、换状态、补跑未试候选、重标注、改 loss、训练、新比赛面板、DAgger 或 PPO
启用 Agent Workflow，搭建新审计框架或开启无边界后续分叉
reason: Only a timing violation is recorded; no concrete implementation counterexample justifies another code repair or broad audit. Three witness-level semantic predicates are sufficient for deciding whether to scope later research.
root_clarifications: Use a fresh output directory and a separate preregistration before any new private read; preserve the original failed review and V2 stage status.
Candidate membership means membership of the saved controller candidate set, not a complete official legality mask or proof of official execution.
Inherited original-data bindings remain inherited; the new task must not claim a second original-data reproduction.
A new case read is separately charged: prior human case read count 1, proposed new count at most 1, cumulative at most 2; machine checker read is separate.
Stop semantic work at 120 seconds, reserve the remaining 60 only for decision and durable receipt; no resetting the 180-second clock or data retry.
If any decisive field is unavailable, record unknown and stop; do not expand to sources, other trials, histories or new simulations.
A successful narrow result may be worth_scoping only. It cannot set original strict acceptance, model admission, economic benefit or whole-state population frequency to true.
scope: One newly registered independent semantic decision over the existing witness; not a retry or retroactive acceptance of V2
